candidates.requirement: The string-parser target must reach supported cleanup of a parser that retains a saved comment after a parse error.
candidates.target_route:
Create the parser with UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS, parse the finite input `#x
!`, then free the parser after the reported error.
candidates.failure_condition: The old target creates the parser with flags 0 and returns on an error before calling ucl_parser_free, so this cleanup state cannot be exercised.
candidates.alternative_paths: Its sole parser creation and cleanup sequence provides no equivalent route.

candidates.requirement: Release an allocated parser after a reported syntax error.
candidates.target_route: Pass the one-byte input `{` to the target. String parsing reaches the unmatched-brace error, which the target queries.
candidates.failure_condition: The target returns from the non-null error branch without freeing the parser.
candidates.alternative_paths: The target's only free call follows the error branch and is bypassed by it.
